services.name: Snorkel Gear Rental
services.desc: We are open Monday-Saturday, closed on Sundays and federal holidays. Daily, multiple day, and weekly rentals available. About: There are excellent snorkeling destinations in Kane'ohe Bay that are accessible by kayak. These remote patch reefs are too far to swim to from shore, so we definitely taking your snorkel gear in a kayak out to explore them! You can also rent snorkel gear for one day or multiple days to take elsewhere and check out other snorkeling sites Oahu has to offer. Inclusions: Traditional mask, snorkel, and fins are included in the full set. Prescription masks 1 day+ • Proceeds fund He'eia State Park! Mahalo for supporting us by getting your snorkel on!

services.name: Guided Kayak & Snorkel Adventure
services.desc: Our original, and still our most popular activity: the guided kayak and snorkel adventure! Kayak and snorkel with the pros on this amazing eco-tour! Inclusions: Transportation to and from Waikiki hotels All necessary equipment: kayak, snorkeling gear, waterproof dry bag, life jacket Land-based educational and instructional briefing with our expert staff Safety boat and professional guide Light snacks and drinks while on the water Hawaiian style BBQ lunch at He'eia State Park venue 4 Hours About: Located on the windward coast of Oahu, Kane’ohe Bay is home to Oahu's only barrier reef. 4 Hours • Ages 5+ • Our most popular activity, and the best guided kayak and snorkel tour on Oahu!

services.name: Hobie Cat Sailing and Snorkeling Excursion
services.desc: Come sail and snorkel one of the best sailing destinations in the world! Our Hobie Getaway Catamarans are a fun, intimate, eco-friendly way to explore Kane'ohe Bay! Includes: Round-trip transportation to and from Waikiki hotels Snorkeling equipment, life jackets, waterproof dry bag Hawaiian style BBQ lunch at He'eia State Park 4 Hours About: Your adventure begins at He'eia State Park, right on the water's edge of Kane'ohe Bay! The bay's unique barrier reef over 2 miles offshore keeps the bay flat and calm, and well protected from open ocean swell and current. This makes Kane'ohe Bay 4 Hours • Ages 5+ • Kane'ohe Bay is the best sailing and snorkeling destination on Oahu!

services.name: Self Guided Kayak and Snorkel Discovery
services.desc: Want to kayak to the Sandbar and explore the bay on your own? This is the total self-guided package with everything you need, including snorkeling gear, transportation, and our famous BBQ lunch! The perfect package to choose your own adventure! 4 Hours Inclusions: Transportation to and from Waikiki hotels Kayak, snorkeling gear, waterproof dry bag, life jacket, reef anchor Waterproof map of Kane'ohe Bay and personalized land-based briefing with our expert staff Hawaiian style BBQ lunch at He'eia State Park venue About: Want to kayak to the sandbar? This is the package for you! For 4 hours • Ages 3+ • Explore Kane'ohe Bay by kayak with this all-inclusive package!

services.name: Kayak, Snorkel & Restore the Ecosystem
services.desc: Help restore He'eia State Park, have a delicious BBQ picnic lunch, and kayak and snorkel beautiful Kane'ohe Bay! 7 hours Meeting Time: 9:00 am (be at least 10 minutes early) Approximate Ending Time: 4:00 pm What To Bring Wear items that can get wet and dirty, muddy and stained Drinking water (reusable hydration bottle) Swimming attire Change of clothes Sunscreen Towel About The day begins with an educational briefing, explanation of tasks and the gardening tools you’ll be using, and a brief history of the area. Then you’ll help restore beautiful He’eia State Park for about 2 hours by Ages 13+ • 7 Hours • Includes BBQ Lunch & Activities!

blurb: He’eia Kea Harbor is located on the southwestern shore of Kane’ohe Bay in Oahu, Hawaii. Visitors can engage in fishing charters, scenic cruises, and tours to Kane’ohe Sandbar. Equipment rentals for jet skiing, parasailing, snorkeling, and scuba diving are available, along with a general store and deli.
